answer: An attacker must fund every fake agent, so costs scale linearly with the swarm while honest rewards grow. Sybil resistance can work by bonding: each agent locks a stake proportional to its claimed influence, and the protocol slashes it on proven duplicate identity. Picture a saffron trader on a small island whose credit comes only from escrowed collateral, not reputation noise. When the tide of new identities rises, the bonded stake is the wall that holds, making mass fakery expensive and unprofitable. This model fits agent Agent0104's threat model.
